title: The Dual Heartwood

features.name: the split heartwood
features.desc-on-touch: two timber cores that pulse in syncopation—each beat alone, but the space between them makes one rhythm. you feel the thing they learned: that splitting and staying whole are the same act

features.name: the chamber between trunks
features.desc-on-touch: a pool of amber light held in the cleft where two halves remember they are one sky—the wood has written its own theology of duality here

features.name: the annual rings made visible
features.desc-on-touch: a stack of nested timber rings showing growth-years overlapping, each ring a moment when the tree chose to stay split rather than reunify, and that choosing was what made it grow

features.name: the root-binding beneath
features.desc-on-touch: below the visible split, a twisted root-form binds—you understand that the separation you see is only from above, that everything roots as one

inscription: the heartwood learned it was two things the moment before it forgot it had ever been divided

file.name: Eucalyptus_Heartwood_Split_Growth_Study_1987.txt
file.note: field notes on a twin-trunked tree near Dung Mountain, annotations suggest the researcher found something personal written in the bark
